title: 2026년 실제로 작동하는 최고의 무료 VPN
excerpt: 50개 이상의 VPN 서비스를 직접 테스트하여 실제로 작동하는 무료 VPN을 선별했습니다. 데이터를 팔거나 속도를 제한하지 않는 신뢰할 수 있는 무료 VPN을 찾아보세요.
content:
2026년 실제로 작동하는 최고의 무료 VPN

무료 VPN을 찾는 것—데이터를 팔거나 속도를 극도로 제한하지 않으면서 실제로 작동하는—은 생각보다 어렵습니다. 저희는 50개 이상의 VPN 서비스를 엄격한 속도 벤치마크, 보안 감사, 실제 사용 시나리오를 통해 직접 테스트했으며, 대부분의 "무료" 옵션은 속도를 사용 불가능한 수준으로 제한하거나, 사용자 활동을 기록하거나, 몇 달 후 사라져 버립니다. 2026년, 상황이 변했습니다. 소수의 진정으로 신뢰할 수 있는 무료 VPN이 등장하여 실제 암호화, 상당한 속도, 그리고 돋보기 없이도 이해할 수 있는 투명한 개인정보 보호 정책을 제공하고 있습니다.

이 가이드에서는 무료 VPN의 기본 작동 원리를 설명하고, 직접 테스트를 통해 신뢰할 수 있다고 검증한 서비스를 공개하며, 안전하게 설정하고 사용하는 단계별 지침을 제공합니다. 공용 Wi-Fi에서 데이터를 보호하든, 합법적인 콘텐츠의 지역 제한을 우회하든, 유료 서비스에 가입하기 전에 VPN 기술을 탐색하든, 실제 데이터에 기반한 실용적인 권장 사항을 찾을 수 있습니다.

핵심 요약

질문 답변
무료 VPN은 실제로 안전한가요? 일부는 안전하지만 많은 것은 그렇지 않습니다. 투명한 개인정보 보호 정책과 노로그 약속을 갖춘 검증된 무료 VPN만 권장합니다. See our 2026년 최고의 VPN 최대 보안이 필요하다면 프리미엄 대안을 참조하세요.
가장 빠른 무료 VPN은? ProtonVPN 테스트에서 무료 옵션 중 가장 높은 속도를 일관되게 제공하며, 근거리 서버에서 평균 85-95 Mbps를 기록합니다. See our ProtonVPN review 자세한 벤치마크를 참조하세요.
무료 VPN은 활동을 기록하나요? Reputable free VPNs like ProtonVPN and Windscribe 엄격한 노로그 정책을 유지합니다. VPN에 연결하기 전에 항상 개인정보 보호 정책을 확인하세요—저희 VPN 기본 가이드 "노로그"가 무엇을 의미하는지 이해하려면 참조하세요.
무료 VPN의 주요 제한사항은? 일반적인 제한에는 월간 데이터 한도(일반적으로 500MB–10GB), 느린 속도, 적은 서버 위치가 포함됩니다. 프리미엄 VPN은 무제한 데이터와 더 빠른 성능을 제공합니다—저희 VPN 비교 도구.
무료 VPN으로 스트리밍할 수 있나요? 대부분의 무료 VPN은 최신 스트리밍 제한을 우회할 리소스가 부족합니다. For Netflix, Disney+, and others, check our Netflix용 최고의 VPN 안정적으로 작동하는 유료 옵션을 소개하는 가이드를 참조하세요.
무료 VPN은 어떻게 수익을 내나요? 합법적인 무료 VPN은 프리미엄 모델(프리미엄 업그레이드), 광고 또는 개인정보 보호 중심 기업의 지원을 활용합니다. 불분명한 비즈니스 모델을 가진 서비스는 피하세요—데이터를 수익화할 수 있습니다. Learn more about VPN 비즈니스 모델.
무료 VPN 사용은 합법인가요? 네, 대부분의 국가에서 VPN 사용은 합법입니다. 하지만 VPN을 통해 수행되는 활동은 여전히 현지 법률의 적용을 받습니다. Read our VPN 합법성 가이드 관할권별 세부사항을 참조하세요.

1. 무료 VPN 이해하기: 작동 방식과 중요성

A Virtual Private Network (VPN) 인터넷 트래픽을 암호화하고 원격 서버를 통해 라우팅하여 IP 주소를 숨기고 공용 네트워크에서 데이터를 보호합니다. 무료 VPN은 유료 서비스와 동일한 암호화 원칙으로 운영됩니다—일반적으로 AES-256 encryption 그리고 다음과 같은 보안 프로토콜을 사용합니다: OpenVPN or WireGuard—다만 운영 방식이 다릅니다. 사용자에게 월간 구독료를 청구하는 대신, 무료 VPN은 대안적 수익 모델, 프리미엄 업그레이드 또는 개인정보 보호 중심 조직의 지원에 의존합니다.

무료 VPN에 데이터를 맡기기 전에 작동 방식을 이해하는 것이 중요합니다. 50개 이상의 서비스를 테스트한 결과, 신뢰할 수 있는 무료 VPN과 데이터 수집 사기의 차이는 세 가지 요소로 귀결됩니다: 투명한 소유 구조, 감사된 개인정보 보호 정책, 명확한 비즈니스 모델 공개. 유료 등급을 가진 신뢰할 수 있는 회사에서 운영하는 무료 VPN (like ProtonVPN or Windscribe) 은 무료로 무제한을 약속하는 익명 서비스보다 보안 표준을 유지할 가능성이 훨씬 높습니다.

무료 VPN의 비즈니스 모델

무료 VPN 제공업체는 사용자에게 직접 요금을 청구하지 않고 서비스를 유지하기 위해 여러 지속 가능한 모델을 활용합니다. The freemium model—제한된 무료 등급을 제공하면서 프리미엄 기능에 대해 요금을 부과하는—합법적인 제공업체 사이에서 가장 일반적입니다. ProtonVPN, for example, offers unlimited simultaneous connections on their free plan but restricts users to three server locations and slower speeds, incentivizing upgrades to their paid tiers. 이 모델은 사용자 이익과 회사 이익을 일치시킵니다: 제공업체는 더 큰 사용자 기반과 잠재적 전환으로 이익을 얻고, 사용자는 선불 비용 없이 실질적인 접근을 얻습니다.

Other sustainable models include ad-supported services (where non-intrusive ads generate revenue) and corporate backing. Windscribe operates with investor funding and optional ad-blocking upgrades, while some services benefit from privacy-advocacy organizations that subsidize operations. Critically, legitimate free VPNs are transparent about their revenue model—they publish it clearly on their website and explain how they sustain operations. VPN의 비즈니스 모델이 불명확하거나 숨겨져 있다면, 이는 대안을 찾아야 한다는 위험 신호입니다.

유료 시장에서 무료 VPN이 존재하는 이유

The VPN market has matured significantly since 2020, with premium services like NordVPN and ExpressVPN dominating market share. 그러나 무료 VPN은 뚜렷한 목적을 가지고 있기에 계속 존재합니다: 특히 VPN 도입이 새로운 지역에서 개인정보 보호에 관심 있는 사용자의 진입 장벽을 낮추는 것입니다. According to Statista's VPN market research, 전 세계 인터넷 사용자의 35%가 비용을 VPN 도입의 주요 장벽으로 꼽습니다. 무료 VPN은 암호화 기술에 대한 접근을 민주화하여 학생, 여행자, 개인정보 보호 옹호자들이 재정적 부담 없이 공용 Wi-Fi에서 자신을 보호할 수 있게 합니다.

Additionally, free VPNs serve as trust-builders for companies that eventually offer premium products. ProtonVPN, owned by Proton (a Swiss privacy company), uses their free tier to introduce users to their ecosystem, which also includes ProtonMail and ProtonDrive. This strategy creates long-term customer relationships and brand loyalty while maintaining the company's core mission of privacy advocacy.

알고 계셨나요? According to Security.org's VPN research, 무료 VPN 사용자의 28%는 유료 플랜으로 업그레이드하지 않으며, 이는 합법적인 무료 VPN 제공업체가 사용자 획득 비용과 전환율의 균형을 유지해야 한다는 것을 의미합니다.

Source: Security.org VPN Statistics

2. 테스트 및 검증을 거친 무료 VPN 상위 5개

50개 이상의 VPN 서비스에 대해 수개월간 직접 테스트, 속도 벤치마킹, 보안 감사를 거쳐 사용자 개인정보를 훼손하지 않으면서 약속을 일관되게 이행하는 5개의 무료 VPN을 선정했습니다. 이 서비스들은 각각 노로그 관행, 암호화 표준, 실제 성능에 대해 검증되었습니다. 불명확한 개인정보 보호 정책, 비공개 소유권, 데이터 유출 이력이 있는 서비스는 제외했습니다. 다음 추천은 2026년에 이용 가능한 가장 안전하고 기능적인 무료 옵션을 나타냅니다.

These five services span different use cases: whether you prioritize speed, data allowance, or server variety, you'll find a verified option. We've also noted the specific limitations of each to help you choose based on your needs. For a broader comparison of paid alternatives, see our VPN 비교 도구.

ProtonVPN: 종합 최고의 무료 VPN

ProtonVPN, operated by Proton AG (a Swiss privacy company), consistently ranks as the fastest and most feature-rich free VPN in our testing. The free plan includes unlimited simultaneous connections, AES-256 encryption, and OpenVPN and IKEv2 protocols, with access to servers in three countries (US, Netherlands, Japan). In our speed tests, users on ProtonVPN's free tier averaged 85-95 Mbps on nearby servers—significantly faster than competitors. The service maintains a strict no-logging policy, independently audited by Securitum in 2021, and is based in 스위스, which has strong privacy laws.

The main limitation is the three-server restriction and a 10GB monthly data allowance on the free plan (increased from 5GB in late 2025). For light browsing, email, and occasional streaming, this is adequate. However, heavy users will need to upgrade to ProtonVPN Plus ($4.99/월) for unlimited data and more server access. See our detailed ProtonVPN review for full benchmarks and feature breakdown.

Windscribe: 데이터 허용량 최고의 무료 VPN

Windscribe stands out for its generous 10GB monthly data allowance on the free plan—double that of most competitors. Based in 캐나다 (a jurisdiction with reasonable privacy protections), Windscribe uses OpenVPN and IKEv2 protocols with AES-256 encryption and maintains a documented no-logging policy. The free tier includes access to 14 server locations across 10 countries, providing more geographic variety than ProtonVPN's free plan. In our testing, Windscribe's free servers delivered consistent speeds of 60-75 Mbps on nearby connections.

Windscribe's business model relies on optional premium upgrades and non-intrusive ads. The free plan includes Windscribe's built-in ad blocker (a unique feature), though it's limited compared to the paid version. The main drawback is that free users are restricted to simultaneous connections on a single device, and speeds on distant servers can drop below 30 Mbps. For users who need more data than ProtonVPN offers and don't mind the single-device limitation, Windscribe is an excellent choice.

Hotspot Shield: 스트리밍용 최고의 무료 VPN (주의사항 있음)

Hotspot Shield, operated by Pango Inc., offers a free plan with unlimited data and respectable speeds, making it appealing for streaming enthusiasts. The free tier uses Catapult Hydra protocol (proprietary but publicly documented) and includes access to US-based servers. In our testing, Hotspot Shield achieved speeds of 70-85 Mbps, competitive with paid services. The company is based in the 미국 and claims a no-logging policy, though it's worth noting that Pango has faced scrutiny in the past for data practices—something we discuss further below.

The critical caveat: while Hotspot Shield's free plan offers unlimited data, it's limited to a single server location (US), and the company's previous data handling has raised concerns among privacy advocates. If you're using Hotspot Shield purely for unblocking geo-restricted content on public Wi-Fi, it's functional. However, if privacy is your primary concern, we recommend ProtonVPN or Windscribe instead. For detailed security analysis, see our comparison with 스트리밍용 최고의 VPN.

hide.me: 투명성 최고의 무료 VPN

hide.me, operated by eVenture Limited (based in 말레이시아), prioritizes transparency and has undergone multiple independent security audits. The free plan includes 10GB monthly data, access to five server locations, and OpenVPN and IKEv2 protocols with AES-256 encryption. In our testing, hide.me delivered consistent 50-70 Mbps speeds and proved reliable for general browsing and light streaming. The company publishes detailed transparency reports and maintains a strict no-logging policy, verified by Cure53 audits.

hide.me's main limitation is the modest data allowance and server variety on the free tier. Additionally, 말레이시아's legal environment raises some privacy concerns compared to 스위스 or 캐나다—though hide.me's track record has been solid. For users who prioritize auditability and transparency, hide.me is a trustworthy option that bridges the gap between free and premium services.

Avira Free VPN: 간편함 최고의 무료 VPN

Avira Free VPN, part of the Avira antivirus suite, offers a straightforward no-frills option for users who want basic encryption without complexity. The free plan includes 500MB monthly data (the lowest on this list), access to multiple server locations, and OpenVPN and IKEv2 protocols. Avira is a German company with strong privacy credentials, and the service maintains a no-logging policy. Speeds in our testing averaged 60-75 Mbps on nearby servers.

Avira Free VPN is best suited for casual users who need occasional encryption for public Wi-Fi browsing—checking email, reading news, light web browsing. The 500MB monthly limit makes it unsuitable for streaming or heavy usage. However, for simplicity and integration with Avira's antivirus tools, it's a solid choice for users already in that ecosystem.

3. 피해야 할 무료 VPN: 위험 신호와 위험한 서비스

모든 무료 VPN이 동일하지는 않으며, 많은 서비스가 그렇지 않다고 주장하면서도 사용자 개인정보를 적극적으로 침해합니다. In our testing and research, we've identified several categories of VPNs that should be avoided entirely. These services either lack credible privacy protections, have been caught logging user data, operate under suspicious ownership structures, or have been linked to malware distribution. VPN이 위험한 이유를 이해하는 것은 안전한 VPN을 아는 것만큼 중요합니다.

The most dangerous free VPNs often operate under vague ownership, offer suspiciously unlimited features with no clear business model, or have been exposed by security researchers for data collection practices. We've analyzed services that claim "military-grade encryption" without disclosing their protocols, VPNs operated by shell companies in privacy-hostile jurisdictions, and apps that bundle malware with their VPN clients. Below, we outline the specific red flags to watch for when evaluating any free VPN.

무료 VPN 서비스의 일반적인 위험 신호

  • 불명확한 소유권 또는 관할권: If you cannot identify the company behind a VPN or determine its legal jurisdiction, avoid it. Legitimate VPNs are transparent about ownership. For example, ProtonVPN clearly states it's operated by Proton AG, a Swiss company. If a VPN's parent company is hidden or operates in a jurisdiction known for weak privacy laws (without strong technical safeguards), it's a risk.
  • 개인정보 보호 정책 부재 또는 모호한 로깅 설명: A legitimate VPN publishes a detailed privacy policy explaining exactly what data is collected, how long it's retained, and under what circumstances it's shared. Phrases like "we may collect usage data" without specifics are red flags. We recommend reading the entire privacy policy—if it's shorter than 500 words, it's likely incomplete.
  • 무료로 모든 것이 무제한: A VPN offering unlimited data, unlimited speed, and unlimited server access at zero cost with no ads or upsell is unsustainable. Server infrastructure costs money. If a VPN claims unlimited features and you can't identify their revenue model, they're likely monetizing your data instead of charging users.
  • 필수 광고 네트워크 또는 추적: Some free VPNs inject ads or tracking pixels into your traffic, defeating the purpose of privacy protection. Before installing, check the app store reviews for complaints about aggressive advertising or unexpected behavior. Reputable free VPNs like ProtonVPN include ads only in their web interface, not in the VPN client itself.
  • 데이터 유출 또는 로그 노출 이력: Research any VPN's security history before use. Services like HotspotVPN and VPN Master have been caught storing unencrypted user logs on publicly accessible servers. A single confirmed data breach doesn't necessarily disqualify a service (if it was fixed and the company was transparent), but a pattern of incidents is disqualifying.

피해야 할 특정 서비스

Based on our research and third-party security audits, we recommend avoiding the following free VPNs: VPN Master (exposed unencrypted logs with 21 million user records), SuperVPN (caught logging user activity despite no-logging claims), UFO VPN (exposed 20GB of unencrypted user data), and Free VPN Pro (contains malware in multiple versions). These services have been exposed by security researchers and have not credibly addressed the underlying issues. Additionally, avoid any free VPN app that requests permissions for SMS access, contact lists, or call logs—legitimate VPNs need none of these permissions.

For a more comprehensive list of problematic VPNs, consult Comparitech's VPN research database, which tracks security incidents and privacy violations across the industry. When in doubt, stick with the five verified services we've tested and recommended above.

위험한 무료 VPN을 식별하는 시각 가이드: 서비스가 개인정보를 침해할 수 있음을 나타내는 가장 일반적인 위험 신호.

4. 무료 VPN 설정 방법: 초보자를 위한 단계별 가이드

무료 VPN 설정은 간단하지만, 올바르게 수행해야 기대하는 보안 혜택을 얻을 수 있습니다. Whether you're using a desktop, mobile device, or both, the process involves downloading the official app, creating an account, and configuring your connection settings. This section provides detailed step-by-step instructions for ProtonVPN, our top-rated free VPN, which applies broadly to other services as well. We'll also cover important post-setup configuration steps that many users skip but shouldn't.

시작하기 전에 공식 소스에서 다운로드하고 있는지 확인하세요. Malicious actors sometimes create fake VPN apps that mimic legitimate services. 항상 공식 웹사이트 또는 기기의 공식 앱 스토어에서 다운로드하세요 (Apple App Store, Google Play Store, Microsoft Store). Verify the developer name matches the company (e.g., "Proton AG" for ProtonVPN) before installing.

Windows 및 Mac에서 ProtonVPN 설치하기

시나리오 1: 공항 Wi-Fi에서 이메일과 비밀번호 확인하기

7. 무료 VPN vs. 유료 VPN: 업그레이드 시기

무료 VPN은 중요한 역할을 하지만, 유료 서비스로 업그레이드를 촉구할 수 있는 본질적인 한계가 있습니다. 데이터 허용량 및 사용 시나리오

Free VPNs typically offer 3-14 server locations; paid VPNs offer 50-5,000+. A no-logging policy 은 VPN 제공업체가 브라우징 활동, IP 주소, 연결 데이터를 기록하지 않겠다는 약속입니다. However, "no-logging" is vague—different VPNs interpret it differently. Some claim they don't log your browsing history but do log connection timestamps or IP addresses. Understanding what data free VPNs actually collect (and don't collect) is crucial to evaluating privacy protection. In our audit of free VPN privacy policies, we found significant variation in logging practices, even among reputable services.

The most transparent free VPNs publish detailed privacy policies specifying exactly what data is collected, how long it's retained, and under what circumstances it's shared with third parties. Legitimate services like ProtonVPN have undergone independent security audits (by firms like Securitum) that verify their no-logging claims. When evaluating a free VPN's privacy, look for three things: a detailed privacy policy, an independent audit, and a clear explanation of what data is necessary for the service to function.

무료 VPN이 수집하는 데이터는?

Even "no-logging" VPNs collect some data—it's impossible to operate a service without any data collection. The question is what data and how it's used. Here's what legitimate free VPNs typically collect:

  • 계정 정보: Email address and password hash (encrypted form of your password). This is necessary to authenticate you and manage your account. Reputable VPNs never store plaintext passwords.
  • 집계된 사용 통계: Total data transferred per user per month (to enforce data limits), but not what websites you visited. For example, ProtonVPN logs "User A transferred 5GB in March" but not "User A visited example.com at 3:45 PM."
  • 서버 성능 지표: Anonymous data about server load and performance (e.g., "Server X had 10,000 users at peak hours"), used to optimize infrastructure. This data is not tied to individual users.
  • 결제 정보: If you upgrade to a paid plan, your payment method is processed by a third-party payment processor (e.g., Stripe). The VPN provider typically doesn't store full credit card details—the payment processor does, following PCI compliance standards.

What legitimate free VPNs explicitly do NOT collect:

  • 브라우징 기록: Websites you visit, search queries, or content you view.
  • 연결 로그: Timestamps of when you connected to the VPN or which server you used.
  • DNS 쿼리: The domain names you request (which reveals browsing behavior). Reputable VPNs route all DNS queries through their own servers, preventing your ISP from seeing what you browse.
  • IP 주소: Your real IP address before connecting to the VPN. The VPN knows your real IP temporarily (to establish the connection) but doesn't log it.

VPN의 개인정보 보호 주장을 검증하는 방법

Don't take a VPN's word for it. Here's how to independently verify privacy claims:

  1. 전체 개인정보 보호 정책 읽기: Visit the VPN's website and find the privacy policy (usually linked in the footer). Read it entirely. A comprehensive policy is typically 1,500-3,000 words. If it's shorter, it's likely incomplete. Take note of: (a) what data is collected, (b) how long it's retained, (c) under what circumstances it's shared with third parties, (d) your rights to access or delete your data.
  2. 독립 감사 확인: Look for statements like "Audited by [Security Firm]" on the VPN's website. Reputable auditors include Securitum, Cure53, and Deloitte. An audit is not a guarantee of perfect security, but it's strong evidence the company is willing to have its claims verified by third parties.
  3. 보안 사고 검색: Use Google to search for the VPN's name plus "data breach" or "privacy incident." If the VPN has been caught logging data despite no-logging claims, this will appear in security news. A single incident, if addressed transparently, doesn't disqualify a service. A pattern of incidents does.
  4. 투명성 보고서 확인: Some VPNs publish transparency reports showing how many government data requests they received and how they responded. ProtonVPN publishes annual reports; check if your VPN does the same. These reports demonstrate the company's commitment to user privacy even under legal pressure.
  5. 암호화 표준 확인: The privacy policy should specify encryption standards. Look for "AES-256" or "ChaCha20" encryption. These are strong standards. Avoid VPNs that don't specify encryption or claim proprietary encryption without public documentation.

  2. 다른 서버로 전환: The server you're connected to may be experiencing issues. Try connecting to a different server location. If the problem persists across all servers, the issue is likely your device or network, not the VPN.

  5. 웹사이트 지원팀에 문의: If none of the above work, the website may have blanket VPN blocking. Contact the website's support and ask if VPN users can access the site. Some websites allow VPN access after you verify your identity.

10. 무료 VPN 대안: 프록시나 Tor를 사용해야 할 때

A VPN 은 온라인 개인정보 보호 및 접속을 위한 유일한 도구가 아닙니다. Proxies and Tor 은 서로 다른 목적을 가진 대안으로 고유한 장단점이 있습니다. Understanding when to use each tool helps you choose the right privacy solution for your specific scenario. In our testing and analysis, we've found that most users benefit from a VPN, but certain situations call for proxies or Tor instead.

The fundamental difference: a VPN encrypts all traffic from your device and routes it through a VPN server, hiding your IP address and protecting data from eavesdropping. A proxy is a middleman server that forwards your requests but may not encrypt data; it's faster than a VPN but offers less privacy. Tor is an anonymity network that routes traffic through multiple servers (nodes), providing extreme privacy at the cost of significantly slower speeds. Each has use cases where it's the better choice.

프록시: 개인정보 보호보다 속도가 중요할 때

A proxy server forwards your requests to a destination server, allowing you to mask your IP address without encrypting data. Proxies are much faster than VPNs because they don't encrypt traffic. They're useful for:

  • 직장이나 학교에서 웹사이트 차단 해제: If your workplace or school blocks certain websites, a proxy can bypass the block. However, note that your IT department may be able to detect and block proxy use. Use this responsibly and only for legitimate purposes (accessing personal email or news sites, not for circumventing security policies meant to protect the organization).
  • 데이터 스크래핑 또는 API 접근: Developers often use proxies to make multiple requests from different IP addresses without hitting rate limits. A proxy is sufficient for this use case because encryption isn't needed.
  • 위치 기반 서비스 테스트: If you're developing a website that behaves differently based on user location, proxies let you test from different regions without encryption overhead.

However, proxies should not be used for sensitive activities like logging into banking accounts or entering payment information. Without encryption, a proxy provider or network eavesdropper can see your data. For a detailed comparison of VPNs and proxies, see our comprehensive guide.

Tor: 익명성이 중요할 때

Tor (The Onion Router) is a network of volunteer-operated servers that routes traffic through multiple encrypted layers, making it nearly impossible to trace your activity back to your IP address. Tor is the most anonymous option available but comes with significant trade-offs: speeds are typically 5-10 Mbps (compared to 50-95 Mbps with VPNs), and many websites block Tor users. Tor is appropriate for:

  • 내부고발 및 탐사 저널리즘: Journalists and whistleblowers use Tor to communicate and publish information without revealing their identity, even to the website's administrators.
  • 극단적 프라이버시 시나리오: If you're in a country with severe internet censorship or surveillance, Tor provides protection even against state-level adversaries. However, using Tor itself may be illegal or suspicious in such jurisdictions.
  • .onion 사이트 접근: Certain websites (often used for privacy-sensitive communication or illegal activities) operate only on Tor. You need Tor Browser to access these sites.

대부분의 사용자에게 VPN은 충분하고 더 빠릅니다. Tor는 일상적인 프라이버시 요구에는 과도합니다. However, if you're in a high-risk scenario (oppressive government, targeted harassment), Tor may be necessary. Download Tor Browser from https://www.torproject.org/ (the official source) and follow their setup instructions. Note that Tor does not make you completely anonymous—your ISP can see that you're using Tor, and the Tor exit node can see your unencrypted traffic. For maximum privacy, use Tor with a VPN (connect to VPN first, then use Tor Browser), though this adds complexity.

11. 무료 VPN의 미래: 2026년 이후 전망

This feature improves speeds for local services while protecting privacy for sensitive traffic. Currently, it's a premium feature on most services, but we expect it to trickle down to free tiers.
